intro.data: No single machine reaches the chart — you'll need a stepping-stone in the middle. Your toolkit holds the machines AND the intermediate Clean Table: bring the ones you need onto the board and chain them. Watch what flows between steps — feed the wrong table into the second machine and it jams or draws the wrong chart.
intro.alchemy: No single apparatus reaches the tool — you'll need a stepping-stone in the middle. Your toolkit holds the apparatuses AND the intermediate Ingot: bring the ones you need onto the board and chain them. Feed the wrong ingot into the second and it jams or makes a blunt tool.
intro.spellcraft: No single rune reaches the beacon — you'll need a stepping-stone in the middle. Your toolkit holds the runes AND the intermediate Flame: bring the ones you need onto the board and chain them. Feed the wrong flame into the second and it jams or makes a dim beacon.
intro.abstract: One step won't reach C. The toolkit holds the machines and the intermediate object B. Read the maps: f sends a ↦ b, h sends b ↦ c (the distractors land on b′ / c′). Place B and chain f then h so the behavior lands on the goal value c.

goal.data: Bring the intermediate Clean Table and the right machines onto the board, and chain them so the messy spreadsheet becomes the clear chart.
goal.alchemy: Bring the intermediate Ingot and the right apparatuses onto the board, and chain them so the raw ore becomes the fine tool.
goal.spellcraft: Bring the intermediate Flame and the right runes onto the board, and chain them so the wild spark becomes the bright beacon.
goal.abstract: Place the intermediate object B and the machines you need, and chain them so the input a becomes the goal value c at C.

afterSuccess.data: Parser then Charter did it — but only because the clean table is exactly what Charter can handle. Shred first and Charter jams; Scribbler always draws the wrong chart. Composition is about behaviors lining up, not just types.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Smelter then Toolsmith did it — only because the pure ingot is what Toolsmith can shape. Composition is about behaviors lining up, not just types.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Ignition then Kindler did it — only because the steady flame is what Kindler can kindle. Composition is about behaviors lining up, not just types.
afterSuccess.abstract: g ∘ f reaches the goal only when the intermediate value is what the second machine expects.

reveal.summary: Composition chains processes: the output of one becomes the input of the next. g ∘ f means do f first, then g — and the value f produces must be one g can act on.
reveal.moreFormal: Composition needs target(f) = source(g) for the types, AND the value f yields must be in the part of B that g handles — otherwise the pipeline jams or diverges.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: g(f(x)) — but f(x) must be something g is actually defined on.
